name: Status cannot drift from the occupancy sessions
title: SC-08-10-02 Status cannot drift from the occupancy sessions
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given any sequence of legal transitions on a unit
Then occupancy_status equals the state implied by the unit's active occupancy session
And the unit's owner equals the active unit_ownerships record
